# space-types-policy — the machine-readable form of the space-types D0 verdict.
#
# ⚠️ VENDORED COPY. Source of truth: testatetech/docs-strategy at
# scripts/data/space-types-policy.txt. Edit there and re-copy.
#
# ⛔ DO NOT EDIT verdict: TO MAKE A RED GATE GREEN. A verdict other than
# UNANSWERED requires a decided-by: line citing a lookup-able decision record —
# a Linear comment URL carrying #comment-<id>, or coordinator-decision:<n>.
# The gate REFUSES a verdict without one, and REFUSES free text (tests T9,
# T22b, T22c).
#
# ── D0 IS ANSWERED. V-OPEN. ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Josh, 2026-09-25 15:13 UTC, coordinator decision record 535, option (a):
#   "V-OPEN — promptText, tier and urgencyFlag stay legitimate open-standard
#    vocabulary."
# ⚠️ An earlier record, 523, answered the same question at 13:16 UTC, before the
# measured brief existed. 535 re-put it with the brief attached and is the later,
# informed answer: 535 governs, and the verdict must not be re-derived from 523.
#
# V-OPEN ratifies the WHOLE file as open standard vocabulary, so open-fields
# lists all EIGHT keys — including `label` and `locales`, which are named in
# none of the three verdict shapes the original question offered and would otherwise
# have been left for a later session to guess. (Plan Task 5's example header
# omitted `locales`; that omission is not the verdict.)
#
# The UNANSWERED freeze pins (frozen-entry-count / frozen-fields / frozen-ids)
# are DELETED rather than left inert: D2a's remedy is an additive change to
# this very file, so a pin that forbids it would contradict the verdict it
# sits under. The published shape they recorded is in git — 3ff5f29a.
#
# ── D2a IS ANSWERED. REMEDY 1. ─────────────────────────────────
# Josh, 2026-09-25 21:07 UTC, coordinator decision record 557, option (a):
#   "Author the `portable` row." Ten of the eleven off-site spaceTypes already
#   carried entries in an identical shape, so excluding this one would have
#   carved out a single value while every sibling stayed in.
#
# NO `exclusions:` LINE IS SET, and after remedy 1 that is correct rather than
# an omission: coverage is complete, so there is nothing to exclude. The gate
# is GREEN at 101/101. reference-data/space-types.json:6 -- "Every enum value
# in space.json has a corresponding entry here" -- is now TRUE as published.
#
# ⛔ An `exclusions:` line added here would re-open D2a, which is answered.
# Do not add one to silence a future red: a new enum value with no entry is
# the gate working, and the remedy is the row, not the carve-out.
#
# Measured against openinherit/standard 02a9889 on 2026-09-25, BEFORE the row:
# 101 enum values, 100 entries, all 8 keys present on all 100. After: 101/101.
#
# ── D0 RE-ANSWERED, 28 September 2026. V-SPLIT SUPERSEDES V-OPEN. ────────
# Josh, coordinator decision record 588:
#   "Regardless of previous decisions I have made I want to make sure we are
#    staying true to any decisions Rich has made previously."
#
# The 25 September V-OPEN verdict (record 535) is WITHDRAWN. It is preserved
# above rather than deleted, per the dated-layer discipline: it was a real
# decision, taken on a real brief, and the record should show a verdict that
# was reversed rather than one that never existed.
#
# ⛔ WHAT V-OPEN MISSED, and it was not a close call. Rich's 28 July moat
# boundary (brand-architecture.md §1.10 item 7) splits the asset-listing core
# -- "its vocabulary open, its elicitation experience proprietary" -- and his
# own worked case 5, in the three-launch design §2, spells out what the
# elicitation experience is:
#
#     "flow, ORDERING, PROMPTS, progress mechanics, the NUDGES that get an
#      ordinary person to finish listing 200 possessions"
#
# tier is the ordering. promptText is the prompts. urgencyFlag is the nudge.
# All three, named by Rich, published in an Apache-2.0 repo.
#
# ⛔ AND THE LEAN-APACHE DEFAULT DOES NOT RESCUE IT. §2's callout keeps that
# default in force -- "where they disagree, or where either is uncertain,
# lean Apache wins" -- but it breaks UNCERTAINTY, and worked case 5 leaves
# none: it names these three things, in these words, as the proprietary half
# of this exact split.
#
# Removal rather than an amendment to the rule because the standard has not
# been publicly utilised yet (Josh, 28 September). Apache distribution is
# one-way: this stops future copies, not any already taken, and the window in
# which removal is still the cheaper answer is open now and will not reopen.
#
# The three fields are not lost -- they are the elicitation experience and
# belong with it, in the proprietary engine, not in the published vocabulary.
verdict: V-SPLIT
decided-by: coordinator-decision:588
open-fields: id,label,aliases,category,locales
commercial-fields: tier,urgencyFlag,promptText
